title: astragalus australis var. aboriginorum
intro: Astragalus australis var. aboriginorum, commonly known as the Aboriginal Astragalus or Aborigine's milk vetch, is a plant species within the legume family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as immune system support. The therapeutic actions of A. australis var. aboriginorum include modulating immune responses, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
